title: RAFT, a competitive playing card game made in 5 hours
author: Necessary-Court2738
selftext:
I sat for 5 hours and created, played, and bug fixed RAFT, the card game. 

RAFT is a competitive card-building game for one or two players — with a fully realized AI opponent available for solo play. Your objective is straightforward and ruthless in equal measure: construct the largest, most valuable raft you can, while ensuring your opponent's does not survive intact.

sabotage your opponent, make smart plays, try it free here today! Have a lovely time. :)

https://zellybeanwizard.itch.io/raftcardgame

comments.author: AgenticGameDev
comments.body: What is the mechanics? I don't get the flow...? Maybe add a tutorial or a AI playing VS AI And a narrator explaing the decissions..... I just placed cards and Lost I guess.... COuld not place any more card for some reason so I sopped playing after 3 such turns ... Solid work in 5 hours. :) What workflows do you use?

replies.author: Necessary-Court2738
replies.body: So you begin by choosing one number card from your hand, the game automatically highlights the center most tile. This is the beginning of your raft. From there player 1 finishes their turn by placing like suits or like numbers against the border of that main card in any cardinal direction. Game continues, click your cards and the game will automatically highlight a legal action for you :)

replies.author: Necessary-Court2738
replies.body: There is also a written tutorial underneath the game, though I will make a video for better clarity :)

replies.author: Necessary-Court2738
replies.body:
My workflow is simply to first create a hand-written rules sheet with decided data values. I then take this sheet and prompt it into a rough draft of the game alongside Claude. 

I play the rough draft myself creating a debug log,

Then I have the Ai implement changes to ONLY the dysfunctional code, appending the bug list

6 or 7 passes of this and you get the above!

20 or 30 passes and I surmise I’ll have a decent app going :)
